title: Amour (bc30)
synopsis: Georges and Anne are in their eighties. They are cultivated, retired music teachers who have spent their lives devoted to their careers and to each other. Savouring their golden years in a comfortable apartment, their serene life is disrupted when Anne experiences a stroke that leaves her partially paralysed. As devoted as Georges is, the infirmities of aging shake his devotion. As he grapples with the formidable task of becoming Anne's full-time caretaker, the couple's bond of love is severely tested. Years after bc's 2008 retrospective "A Master of Provocation", Haneke entered a new chapter, facing mortality with rare tenderness.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 退休鋼琴教授夫妻喬治與安妮數十年來風雨同路，作風低調，踏實中盡是深愛和尊敬的痕跡。無論生老病死、貧富貴賤，兩人始終同甘共苦，直到安妮患上不治頑疾，堅定不移的真愛始面臨前所未有的考驗。喬治每天看着愛妻從雍容逐漸走向凋零，身心飽受折磨；他能否承擔牽緊對方軟弱雙手的責任，挽救彼此脆弱心靈？所謂「愛」，真能以至死不渝的優美姿態，不離不棄走過人生最終篇章嗎？ bc 曾在 2008 年以「挑釁大導」為題辦漢尼卡作品展，至此時，他又踏入了創作的另一階段，以克制與溫柔凝視生命的凋零。

cast: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Emmanuelle Riva, Isabelle Huppert
